english.title: Failing to surrender driving licence and / or counterpart because of error
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person whose licence had been revoked by virtue of section 99(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988, failed without reasonable excuse to deliver up the

(A)_[licence]_
(B)_[licence and counterpart]_

to the Secretary of State forthwith
english.legislation: Contrary to section 99(5) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) The option 'licence and its counterpart' relates to licences which came into force on or after 1st June 1990 (1st January 1991 in the case of licences granted under the law of Northern Ireland). The "counterpart" details endorsements and provisional entitlements.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, whose driving licence had been revoked by the Secretary of State, failed to deliver up the

(A)_[licence]_
(B)_[licence and its counterpart]_

to the Secretary of State forthwith.
